slices.focus: Caleb discovers paper scorekeeping at an Astros game with Miguel, finding a structured, low-pressure way to decompress
slices.summary: After a late meeting, Miguel invites Caleb to an Astros game where he learns compact paper scorekeeping. The activity gives his attention a clean job and keeps him from checking his phone. He comes home noticeably lighter, and Lena comments on the difference. He decides to keep a pencil and card in his truck for future spontaneous games.
decisions: Caleb discovered he liked keeping a simple paper scorecard during Astros games when someone else showed him how.
